spans.s:
(डु, ष्) डुपचष् r. 1st cl. (पचति)
To mature by cooking or ripening, to boil, to dress, to ripen;
(इ) पचि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पंचति-ते पंचयति)
1 To make evident or apparent.
2 To represent, to state fully.
3 To spread.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Who or what cooks, matures, &c.
m. (-चः)
Cooking, maturing, &c.
E.
पच to cook, aff. अच्.

f. (-चा)
Cooking, dressing, maturing, ripening.
E.
पच to dress, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-चा)
Cooking, maturing.
E.
पच to cook, causal v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-कः)
A cook.
E.
पच to cook, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 What produces maturity.
2 What cooks or dresses.
3 Digestive, tonic, what effects digestion.
n. (-कं)
The bile which assists in digestion.
m. (-कः)
1

Fire.
2

A cook.
E.
पच to ripen or concoct, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्)
Cooking, ripening.
E.
पच to cook, participial aff. शतृ.

m. (-तः)
1 The sun.
2

Fire.
3

A name of INDRA.
E.
पच to cook or ripen, Uṇādi aff. अतच्.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) or adv. n. (-ल्पं)
Almost cooked or ripened.
E.
पचति what cooks, and कल्प aff.; implying incompleteness; also in a similar sense पचतिदेश्य and पचतिदेशीय.

m. (-टः)
A tree, (Hibiscus phæniceus.)
E.
पचत् here said to mean the sun, and पुट to shine, aff. क.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं)
What books or matures, &c.
n. (-नं)
1 Cooking, dressing, boiling.
2 Maturing.
m. (-नः)
Fire.
E.
पच to cook, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 What cooks or ripens, &c.
2

Digestive.
3

Suppurative.
n. (-नं)
1 A medicinal preparation, an infusion, a decoction, &c. of various drugs, chiefly carminatives or gentle stimuli given to bring the vitiated humours in fever, &c. to maturity, a sort of diet drink.
2 Penance, expiation.
m. (-नः)
1

Fire.
2

Acidity, sourness.
f. (-नी)
A sort of myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
E.
पच to dress, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Cooking, in the act of cooking or ripening.
E.
पच to cook, &c. and शानच् aff., मुक् augment.

f. (-चा)
A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.)
E.
पच to cook, reiterated, अच् aff. and मुम् inserted; it is also read पचम्बचा.

Fire.
2

Cooking, maturing.
E.
पच to be cooked, (by it,) इन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-चिः)
Cooking, maturing.
E.
पच to cook, इञ् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Fit to cook or ripen of itself.
m. (-मः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
E.
पच to dress or ripen, केलिमन् aff. of the reflective form, or Uṇādi aff. एलिमन्.

m. (कः)
A cook.
E.
पच, and एलुक aff.

ind.
Foot by foot, or stanza by stanza.
E.
पत् for पाद, and शश् aff. of several orders.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being in the act of ripening. cooking &c.
E.
पच to cook, pass. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-स्त्री)
A she cook.
E.
पाचक cooking, स्त्री a woman.

m. (-कः)
1 Borax.
n. (-कं)
A sort of diet drink: see the last.
E.
पच to mature, (metals,) in the causal form, ल्युट् aff., and कन् added.

n. (-लं)
Cooking, maturing.
m. (-लः)
1

Fire.
2

Wind.
3

A thing dressed or matured without the aid of fire.
4 Whatever ripens, cooks, causes digestion, &c.
E.
पच in the causal form, अलच् aff.

f. (-का)
Cooking, maturing.
E.
पच to cook, ण्वुल् aff.
